definitions.explanation: Describing an attitude or behavior that pushes back against authority, ideas, or pressure.
Describing a physical or psychological force that pushes things apart or away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: He took a defiant attitude toward his boss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{思春期|ししゅんき}→思春期：12667_shishunki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反発的|はんぱつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Adolescent children tend to become resistant toward their parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: Citizens showed a resistant reaction to the new policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{極|きょく}→極：13150_kyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{磁石|じしゃく}→磁石：04211_jishaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反発的|はんぱつてき}だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{性質|せいしつ}→性質：01638_seishitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: This material has a water-repellent property.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集団|しゅうだん}→集団：03211_shuudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: A repulsive force is at work between the two groups.

notes:
A na-adjective formed from ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧ (repulsion; resistance) plus ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Sense 1 describes psychological or social resistance, while sense 2 describes physical repulsion. The word ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧ itself has both meanings, and the adjective inherits them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: resistant attitude
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧: oppositional reaction
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧: repulsive force
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become defiant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反抗的|はんこうてき}→反抗的：21089_hankouteki⟧: rebellious; defiant — stronger than {反発的|はんぱつてき}, implying active resistance against authority
- ⟦{敵対的|てきたいてき}→敵対的：25936_tekitaiteki⟧: hostile; antagonistic — implies deeper hostility rather than mere resistance
- ⟦{批判的|ひはんてき}→批判的：05665_hihanteki⟧: critical — intellectual opposition through analysis rather than emotional pushback
